name: lobe-chat-pro
description: lobe-chat-pro — Chinese fork of LobeChat with commercial backend: user management, billing, payments (WeChat/Stripe), AI image/video canvas (Midjourney, Kling, Doubao), music (Suno), admin panel.

stack.frontend: Next.js 15, React 19, TypeScript, Ant Design, antd-style

admin: User management (groups, billing rates, invite rewards)
Model management (providers, pricing per token/request, API keys)
Payment integrations (WeChat Pay, Yipay, HuPiJiao, Stripe)
ai_canvas: Image generation: Google, OpenAI, Midjourney, Kling, Doubao
Video generation: Google, OpenAI, Kling, Doubao
Image editing: upscale, background removal, layer extraction, inpainting, expansion
features.drawing_panel: Midjourney, Kling, OpenAI, Doubao with custom parameters and inpainting

security_review.notes: Standard Next.js web app. docker-compose/setup.sh downloads config files from GitHub via wget (no eval of content). No eval() of remote content in TypeScript source. No curl|bash patterns. CLAUDE.md/AGENTS.md are developer guidelines only — not copied as project settings.
